decisions.reason: Matching the reference applies specifically to caption lettering; it does not change the existing clean-editing, effects, or transition rules.
The full-lesson clause reiterates the existing completeness requirement and its observed violation is already represented by the same-message runtime failure; it does not modify current values.
The reference video demonstrates lettering style and does not replace or narrow the permitted source videos used to create clips.
Requiring a full lesson concerns moment completeness, not a change to the separate standard for selecting strong or impactful source moments.
The reference to a 30-second video criticizes ending before the full lesson; it does not establish a new duration range or alter the existing 45-to-60-second bounds.
This corrective feedback concerns current clip lettering and lesson completeness, not the earlier qualification method, clip count, deadline, or success condition.
The caption and lesson feedback does not change Lead Clipper assignment, training, advancement, or responsibilities.
The message requests content corrections but does not change who approves clips, which clips count, or how rejected clips are handled.
The requested visual and content corrections do not change the monthly quota, counting rule, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
The message does not change the approval prerequisite or the dedicated Instagram publishing destination.
The source provides editing feedback and does not alter the submission channel, folder configuration, review-link delivery, or planned Notion workflow.
